In this video, we will demonstrate
Schematic Preference Settings for Navigation.

Schematic Preferences
are system specific settings

which help you control the behavior
and display of the schematic editor
to suit your needs and working style.

Let's have a look at some basic preferences
you may want to change for the navigation.
Let us first explore design insights.
Open the Preferences
and select System,
and then Design Insight.

Ensure the checkbox
for Enable Connectivity Insight, is checked.

Within the Connectivity Insight Options
section,

ensure all options are enabled
within the Mouse Hover column.
Click OK to close the Preferences dialog.
In the Projects panel,
right-click on the Source Documents folder
and select Open All Schematic Documents.
Make the schematic your focus document.
Then hover your mouse over a sheet symbol block.

A large thumbnail of the document
appears next to the cursor.

Next, hover the cursor
over the bus,

the large thumbnail
will appear next to the cursor,

which shows the connections
in the design.

Below the thumbnail is a list of all the
schematic sheets where the bus is present.

Hovering over these listed schematic sheets
changes the thumbnail view

to match the schematic document
that the cursor currently hovers over.

Left-click the document from the pop-up insight
to open the schematic sheet.

Notice that the wires or busses
that connect to the sheet entry,
that the cursor was hovering over,

are now shown
while the rest of the objects are dimmed.

Press ‘Shift + C’ on the keyboard
or left-click anywhere in the design

to clear any selection,
highlights, or dimming.

This is a great way to use
Connectivity Insight

to quickly navigate and explore
connectivity throughout a schematic.
Open the Preferences again
and select Set To Defaults,

then default page in the lower left
corner of the Design Insight page
to reset the default preferences.
Click OK to exit the dialog.
In this video,

we explored Schematic Preference settings
related to the navigation.

title: Altium Training - Navigating Schematics: Schematic Preference Settings for Navigation
